object.description: Setup: a workout from an outdoor walk of 200 m, exported from Settings. Steps: 1. Validate the file against the GPX 1.1 schema with xmllint. 2. Read the file as UTF-8 and read the track name. 3. Compare the track points with the route of the workout. Expected: 0 schema errors; the XML declaration names UTF-8; the track name equals the activity type; the start time and the track points match the workout.
